# SFigure 2A
```{r}
row_order = c("HLALOH", "HLA-A", "B2M", "NLRC5", "TAP1", "HLA-B", "ERAP2", "TAP2", "TAPBP", "ERAP1", "PSMB8", "HLA-C", 
              "PSMB10","PSMB9", "Homozygous Deletion")

mat1 <- fread(paste0(path_APMall, "onco_APM_hlaloh.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, header = T) %>% column_to_rownames("V1")

title = "Antigen Presentation Machinery"
filename = paste0(path_figure, "/SFigure2a.pdf")
pdf(paste0(filename), width = 7.5, height = 2.5)
      ht1 <-  oncoPrint(mat1,
                        alter_fun = alter_fun,
                        alter_fun_is_vectorized = T,
                        pct_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), 
                        col = col,
                        row_order = row_order,
                        show_pct = T,
                        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), 
                        column_title = title,
                        top_annotation = NULL,
                        remove_empty_columns = TRUE,
                        heatmap_legend_param = heatmap_legend_param,
                        pct_side = "right", 
                        row_names_side = "left")
draw(ht1, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()
```
